545:t_010:0.en:
$$カスパー$$
「That's too bad, $$ウェーバー$$... It seems my range was just a little longer than your detection range.」

545:t_010:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「You did well, $$カスパー$$. I'm glad I positioned you here just in case.」

545:t_010:2.en:
$$カスパー$$
「What do we do next?」

545:t_010:3.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'm going to $$ヤムスク１１$$. Come with me.」

545:t_011:0.en:
$$レナード$$
「You came close, $c. It wasn't a bad plan.」

545:t_011:1.en:
$$レナード$$
「But our strength always exceeds your expectations. It always has... and always will.」

545:t_012:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「$$レナード$$'s machine is heading toward $$ヤムスク１１$$!」

545:t_012:1.en:
$$ラム$$
「Master Sergeant $$ウェーバー$$ isn't responding!」

545:t_012:3.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Answer me, $$ウェーバー$$!」

545:t_012:5.en:
$$モニカ$$
「$$アマルガム$$ reinforcements are coming!」

545:t_013:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「Now we can't pursue $$レナード$$ or check whether $$クルツ$$ is all right...!」

545:t_013:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「So we're dancing in the palm of his hand...!」

545:t_013:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「Didn't we decide we wouldn't give up!?」

545:t_013:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「$$宗介$$ and $n are with $$テッサ$$! And we don't know that $$クルツ$$ is dead!」

545:t_013:5.en:
$$マオ$$
「What we have to do is find a way through this!」

545:t_013:7.en:
$$マオ$$
(I won't let you screw me and run, $$クルツ$$...! You're going to take responsibility!)

545:t_014:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Have we heard from $$宗介$$ and the others!?」

545:t_014:1.en:
$$ルカ$$
「No! They aren't responding to our calls either!」

545:t_014:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Explosions have been going off at $$ヤムスク１１$$ for some time...」

545:t_014:3.en:
$$桂$$
「Even if we try to investigate, with these guys here...!」

545:t_015:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Another pain in the ass has shown up!」

545:t_016:1.en:
$$カレン$$
「They attacked their own allies in $$アマルガム$$!」

545:t_016:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm all for you fighting each other, but go do it somewhere we're not.」

545:t_016:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The $$ジェニオン$$ is coming!」

545:t_017:1.en:
$n
「$$宗介$$ and I are both fine!」

545:t_017:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「The Captain is taking shelter! Launch the $$レーバテイン$$!」

545:t_019:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「What happened to $$クルツ$$? I don't have a signal from his $$Ｍ９$$...」

545:t_019:1.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「$$ウェーバー$$ is...」

545:t_019:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「We'll talk later! First, we finish off the enemy in front of us!」

545:t_019:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$尸空#pilot$$! Let's pick up where we left off!」

545:t_020:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You should have tasted despair. Why do you fight?」

545:t_020:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't decide where we're headed for us.」

545:t_020:2.en:
$$桂$$
「Sorry, but we don't know when to quit.」

545:t_020:3.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「$$始原の特異点$$s... You are the ones who should learn to give up.」

545:t_020:4.en:
$$桂$$
「You're going to spout the same crap about us not being able to repair space-time, aren't you?」

545:t_020:5.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「...Humans cannot change the world... or the past. $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ should learn that too.」

545:t_020:7.en:
$$桂$$
「Wait, $$宗介$$. We'll take care of him.」

545:t_021:1.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I have no intention of listening to your optimism.」

545:t_022:0.en:
$$桂$$
「My name isn't $$始原の特異点$$! I'm... $$桂木桂$$!!」

545:t_022:2.en:
$$桂$$
「Let's do it, $$オルソン$$! The two of us are going crab hunting!」

545:t_023:1.en:
$$桂$$
「Listen up, $$サイデリアル$$! I may not look it, but I'm a man who repays his debts!」

545:t_023:2.en:
$$桂$$
「If I can save the world as a $$特異点$$, I'll do it, no matter what anyone says!」

545:t_023:3.en:
$$桂$$
「If $$オルソン$$ and I aren't enough, we'll find that rumored third one!」

545:t_024:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'd expect nothing less of a handsome man who transcends space-time. You even managed to move his heart.」

545:t_025:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「We've confirmed the Imperial forces have withdrawn.」

545:t_025:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Send in the ground troops at once. Check whether Master Sergeant $$ウェーバー$$ is all right.」

545:t_026:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「That's the one! That's the one that got $$クルツ$$...!」

545:t_027:0.en:
$$カスパー$$
「If you can see this woman, stop resisting.」

545:t_027:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What do you intend to demand with Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ as your hostage?」

545:t_027:5.en:
$$カスパー$$
「$$ミスタ・Ａｇ$$... $$レナード・テスタロッサ$$ requests your cooperation.」

545:t_027:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So this is effectively a demand that we surrender...」

545:t_027:7.en:
$$カスパー$$
「Who knows... Ask him for the rest.」

545:t_027:8.en:
$$宗介$$
($$レナード$$... So this is how you're removing us, the greatest obstacle to your ambition...)

545:t_027:9.en:
$$宗介$$
(And losing the Captain now means losing our way to stop $$レナード$$'s ambitions...)
